claim_boundary: Cross-route reconciliation establishes evidence availability and route coverage only. It does not establish source attribution, causation, exposure, health effect, permit breach or regulatory non-compliance.
interpretation: The live SOS route and the 30-day AURN review are separate official Defra publication routes with different time roles. A station absent from live SOS but present with valid 30-day hourly evidence is a live-source-route coverage gap, not an absent monitoring station. Annual hourly files must not be substituted into the live SOS screen because they do not provide equivalent latest-data freshness. Conversely, live SOS presence does not guarantee sufficient valid hourly evidence for the governed 30-day review window.
period_source_route: Defra UK-AIR annual hourly AURN site_data files
